g.title: pipeline_pred
g.text: Branch B: WALL_BC → PART_MOM → DIV_P1 (writes div_s, dsum)
Join at: DIV_PART_2 (needs flux + div_s + DDDT)
VELOCITY_FLUX reads: vel, rho, visc, div, edge
WALL_BC reads: vel, rho_s, species_s, temp, wall
WALL_BC writes: temp(bdy), wall, pbar, energy

g.title: pipeline_corr
g.text: RADIATION → EX(2) → DIV_P1 (long chain, writes div, dsum)
Join at: DIV_PART_2 (needs flux + div + DDDT)
the combustion/particle/wall/radiation chain takes much longer.
This overlap is "free" — flux is ready before DIV_P2 needs it.

g.title: summary
g.text: vel/vel_s, rho/rho_s, species/species_s, diff, wall, pbar
vel/vel_s, rho/rho_s, visc (MU), div/div_s, pres, edge
div/div_s, pbar/pbar_s, dsum, vel, vel_s, wall
flux, dddt, vel/vel_s, rho/rho_s, wall, visc (KRES)
